goal: Prevent autonomous implementation or deployment of net-new AnyTour DS2 mockups before the owner has explicitly approved the corresponding visual direction, while allowing already-approved redesign lanes to continue through implementation and verification.
done_when: net-new visual directions require explicit owner approval evidence before implementation
already-approved mockups may proceed without repeated approval requests
user-facing redesign PRs are not merged until their task-required visual QA is satisfied
AnyTour Design System 2.0 remains the only canonical design system
evidence: Owner clarified on 2026-09-01 that the current phase is development and approval of new design/mockups before implementation. Existing SEARCH_2_0_MOCKUP_APPROVAL remains valid for the design direction it explicitly covers.
